states.active: Grow flowers in the meadow behind Edda's cottage.
states.bloomed: Edda has come out to the bench. Go and sit with her.
states.complete: Come back in a few weeks. Not years. Weeks.

journal.active: Edda Brenn's husband Jonas kept a garden behind their cottage. It gave up two springs after he did. I offered a spell.
journal.bloomed: The meadow is flowering. Edda came outside on her own. I should go to her.
journal.complete: Done, and noted, so that I remember: weeks, not years.
